en: The front features a black-and-white photograph of a panoramic riverside landscape with hills, trees, fencing, and a long steel bridge crossing a wide river. The caption reads 'Indalselfven' and 'Käftsbron,' indicating the scene is of the Indalsälven river and the then-famous Käfstabron (bridge) in Sweden. Handwritten Swedish text is visible at the bottom. The back is a traditional postcard layout with ornate green border, Swedish address text, and a Swedish stamp.
